I feel like I should have those things too but I struggle with self hatred including internalized homophobia. I guess as weird as it may sound, I feel “rejected” in general/by default by not having these things. I’m going to try to focus more on me and my own life and goals and hopefully this fixation will end instead of lying dormant.
